Title: Puzzles for everyone, reef currents and distinct weapons
Changes: Five new puzzle rooms: Ice Hall, Aqueduct Room, Ember Hall, Counting Room and Lantern Path. A run shows every kind before one repeats.
The room that needed one player on every plate is gone. Every puzzle can be solved by one player or by the whole team.
New PUZZLES ONLY mode on the PLAY page and in the CO-OP lobby: six puzzle maps in a row, harder each time, ending with your medals.
Lumenreef Basin has water currents that appear and vanish at random, level or vertical, and carry you along when you swim into them.
Weapons that looked or played alike now differ: 19 groups got their own pattern, shape, impact and firing sound, with balance kept.
The Reef Leviathan swims upright with its own colours, and cave sharks swim head first.
No health bars float over hidden burrowing enemies, and puzzle rooms stay inside the minimap circle.
A phase boss thrown far off the map now comes back near the players instead of walking back for minutes.
Co-op protocol 17: all players must update together.
